headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 14, 2026**
article:
The Baltimore Orioles made two notable moves, transferring left-hander Keegan Akin to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort and acquiring right-hander Cam Sanders from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash. 

Injuries have impacted several teams, with notable players including Zac Gallen (Arizona Diamondbacks), Chris Martin (Texas Rangers), Nick Lodolo (Cincinnati Reds), William Kempner (Miami Marlins), Brandon Woodruff (Milwaukee Brewers), Mike Yastrzemski (Atlanta Braves), and Anthony Banda (Minnesota Twins) all being placed on the injured list due to various injuries.

The trade market has been active, with the Baltimore Orioles acquiring Cam Sanders from the Pittsburgh Pirates, the Milwaukee Brewers acquiring Braden Shewmake from the Houston Astros, and the Minnesota Twins acquiring Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays.

top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles left-hander Keegan Akin has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort. The move is a result of a status change.

top_news.title: **Orioles Acquire Cam Sanders in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-hander Cam Sanders, who was traded to the Orioles from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash.
